text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I ran the quarterly access export for admin roles. Found 12 principals with 'org-admin' or equivalent on analytics-cluster that show no activity in >180d. 4 are service accounts and 2 of those have cross-project KMS grants. audit-bot posted the full CSV: https://redwood.internal/s/exports/q1-admin-audit.csv :eyes:

audit-bot: automated summary: 12 stale admins, 4 svcacct hits, 2 KMS-cross grants, 3 owners missing. See attached CSV.

jordan: Can you paste one example of the KMS binding so infra knows the exact command?

maya: Sure — example redacted. For GCP keys we saw bindings like this:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/prod-keys/locations/global/keyRings/analytics-key/cryptoKeys/ingest-key 
# look for members: serviceAccount:legacy-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
For AWS KMS (if relevant):
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab 
# check GranteePrincipal entries for cross-account principals
```

liam: Important: revoking a KMS grant without rewrapping can break decrypts for running backfills. :warning: We need owner-confirmed mitigation plan before stripping grants.

maya: Agreed. Proposed short plan: 1) Temporarily remove "admin" role but preserve KMS grants while we confirm owners (read-only hold). 2) Open owner outreach tickets with 7-day SLA for response. 3) If owner confirms active use, schedule a safe rotation window and rewrap keys. 4) If no response, remove grants and rotate keys, plus create rollback playbook.

sophie: Those two legacy SAs are definitely tied to payroll reingest from 2019 — i'm looping in finance owners now. I'll own the payroll tickets.

anita: Legal note — any key rotation affecting financial PII requires our signoff and an archival proof that re-encrypt happened. Keep me on the loop.

jordan: For the tickets, please include the minimal repro (service account email, last-auth timestamp, KMS key id) and the suggested safe window (2h off-peak). Example ticket body: 
```
SvcAcct: legacy-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
LastAuth: 2024-08-12T04:22Z
KMS: projects/prod-keys/.../ingest-key
Proposed action: reduced privileges -> owner confirmation -> rotate+rewrap in maintenance window (2h)
```

maya: I'll carve those tickets now and assign: maya -> audit followups, sophie -> payroll owners, jordan -> infra support for rotation window, liam -> SRE rollback plan, anita -> legal signoff. Target: owner responses in 7 days, rotation scheduled in next 14 days if needed.

liam: I'll draft a rollback runbook snippet with the exact decrypt fallback steps and smoke tests. Will post here when ready.

sophie: Confirmed owners contacted. Posted owner emails in ticket. :thumbsup:

maya: Quick blocker — one of the SAs is also a member of an open-source onboarding pipeline, which we might need to keep. I'll mark it exception and add to a whitelist with expiration.

jordan: Ops checklist for rotation (pre): snapshot KMS key policy, snapshot list-grants, snapshot service logs (last 30 days). Commands: 
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy <key> > /tmp/key-policy.json
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloud_kms AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"legacy-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\"" --limit 100
```

maya: Thanks. Last note: I'm tagging this as part of the quarterly least-privilege sweep. Will update the CSV with owner status and final disposition (retain/rotate/remove) once tickets close. Planning a follow-up sync next Tuesday 10:30 PT.

audit-bot: thread flagged for weekly compliance digest.
